An '''ion-collector pod''' was a power source that was regularly employed as a [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] source for [[Hoersch-Kessel ion drive]]s in <ref name="SWS" /> in place of [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] or [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]].<ref name="SWS2E">[[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Star Wars Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>
